scope: 56-frame contact-window MiniMax-H3 protected flow-inversion selection at sigma 0.08
summary: The weaker sigma 0.08 flow-inversion candidate passed the contact-window temporal and spatial gates and was selected for full 27.5-second expansion.
evidence: Mean robot-ROI jerk fell from 6.3177944 to 5.9292160, a ratio of 0.9384946.
The 56-frame result decoded fully, the bounded edit fraction passed, and pixels outside the tracked safety envelope were exact before encoding.
The selected configuration used six Heun inversion steps, sixteen forward steps, model mix 0.65, and no noise refresh.
lessons: Weak, reversible latent movement is better suited than a broad regeneration pass when geometry, flowers, and background are already accepted.
A pinned v78 detail residual can recover texture after the model pass without reopening the protected background.
limitations: WORKING is scoped to frames 236--291 and third-party MiniMax-H3 NF4 weights; a full-timeline result still required window, seam, and visual acceptance.
next_actions: Run overlapping 124-frame windows over all 660 frames and enforce exact flower/background restoration during stitching.
